title: Activation Checkpointing & Offloading Selection: Selective Recomputation & PCIe Gen5 Async Offload vs. Full Checkpointing

workload_basis.model: Llama-3-70B Training at 16K Context Length (BF16 + FlashAttention-3)
workload_basis.gpu_sku: NVIDIA H100 80GB / H200 141GB (PCIe Gen5 x16 56 GB/s DMA)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: No Activation Checkpointing (Store All Intermediate Activations in HBM)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Fails with CUDA OOM on 80GB H100 (46GB states + 98GB activations = 144GB)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Full Layer Activation Checkpointing (--recompute-granularity full)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Emergency memory fallback (wastes +33.3% FLOPs recomputing all Linear GEMMs)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Selective Activation Checkpointing (Save GEMMs, Recompute Attention/SwiGLU Only)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard 8K-32K context training when HBM has >=25GB headroom

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Selective Op Checkpointing + Async PCIe Gen5 Pinned-DRAM Offload
tiers.recommended_scenario: Long-context 16K-128K training maximizing both batch size and effective MFU (+36% vs Full)
